description: Tiny example General Modeling Network Specification (GMNS) network synthesized from OpenStreetMap for the historic downtown core of Leavenworth, Washington. Bundled with netstead for tests and the 5-minute getting-started example.
name: leavenworth-wa

schema.description: A list of vertices that locate points on a map. Typically, they will represent intersections, but may also represent other points, such as a transition between divided and undivided highway. Nodes are the endpoints of a link (as opposed to the other type of vertex, location, which is used to represent points along a link)

fields.description: Primary key
fields.name: node_id

fields.description: Coordinate system specified in config file (longitude, UTM-easting etc.)
fields.name: x_coord

fields.description: Coordinate system specified in config file (latitude, UTM-northing etc.)
fields.name: y_coord

fields.description: Optional. Altitude in short_length units.
fields.name: z_coord

fields.description: Optional. What it represents (intersection, transit station, park & ride).
fields.name: node_type

fields.description: Optional. Intersection control type.
fields.name: ctrl_type

fields.description: Optional. Could be a Transportation Analysis Zone (TAZ) or city, or census tract, or census block.
fields.name: zone_id

fields.description: Optional. Associated node. For example, if this node is a sidewalk, a parent_nodek_id could represent the intersection  it is associated with.
fields.name: parent_node_id

schema.name: node.schema.json

schema.description:
A link is an edge in a network, defined by the nodes it travels from and to. It may have associated geometry information. Links have three types of attributes:
- Those that define the physical location of the link (e.g., `shape` `information`, `length`, `width`)
- Those that define the directionality of the link: `from_node`, `to_node`
- Those that define properties in the direction of travel: capacity,free flow speed, number of lanes, permitted uses, grade, facility type

fields.description: Primary key - could be SharedStreets Reference ID
fields.name: link_id

fields.description: Optional. Street or Path Name
fields.name: name

fields.description: Required. Origin Node
fields.name: from_node_id

fields.description: Required. Destination Node
fields.name: to_node_id

fields.description: Required. Whether the link is directed (travel only occurs from the from_node to the to_node) or undirected.
fields.name: directed

fields.description: Optional. Foreign key (Link_Geometry table).
fields.name: geometry_id

fields.description: Optional. Link geometry, in well-known text (WKT) format. Optionally, other formats supported by geopandas (GeoJSON, PostGIS) may be used if specified in geometry_field_format in gmns.spec.json
fields.name: geometry

fields.description: Optional. The parent of this link. For example,for a sidewalk, this is the adjacent road.
fields.name: parent_link_id

fields.description:
Optional.
1 shapepoints go from from_node to to_node;
-1 shapepoints go in the reverse direction;
0 link is undirected or no geometry information is provided.
fields.name: dir_flag

fields.description: Optional. Length of the link in long_length units
fields.name: length

fields.description: % grade, negative is downhill
fields.name: grade

fields.description: Facility type (e.g., freeway, arterial, etc.)
fields.name: facility_type

fields.description: Optional. Saturation capacity (passenger car equivalents / hr / lane)
fields.name: capacity

fields.description: Optional. Free flow speed, units defined by config file
fields.name: free_speed

fields.description: Optional. Number of permanent lanes (not including turn pockets) in the direction of travel open to motor vehicles. It does not include bike lanes, shoulders or parking lanes.
fields.name: lanes

fields.description: Optional. Type of bike facility along the link.
fields.name: bike_facility

fields.description: Optional. Type of pedestrian accommodation along the link
fields.name: ped_facility

fields.description: Optional. Type of parking along the link.
fields.name: parking

fields.description: Optional. Set of allowed uses that should appear in either the use_definition or use_group tables; comma-separated.
fields.name: allowed_uses

fields.description: Optional.  Toll on the link, in currency units.
fields.name: toll

fields.description: Optional.  Owner/operator of the link.
fields.name: jurisdiction

fields.description: Optional. Width (short_length units) of the entire right-of-way (both directions).
fields.name: row_width

schema.name: link.schema.json

schema.description: The geometry is an optional file that contains geometry information (shapepoints) for a line object. It is similar to Geometries in the SharedStreets reference system. The specification also allows for geometry information to be stored directly on the link table.

fields.description: Primary key - could be SharedStreets Geometry ID
fields.name: geometry_id

fields.description: Link geometry, in well-known text (WKT) format.  Optionally, other formats supported by geopandas (GeoJSON, PostGIS) may be used if specified in geometry_field_format in gmns.spec.json.
fields.name: geometry

schema.name: geometry.schema.json

schema.description: The lane file allocates portions of the physical right-of-way that might be used for travel. It might be a travel lane, bike lane, or a parking lane. Lanes only are included in directed links; undirected links are assumed to have no lane controls or directionality. If a lane is added, dropped, or changes properties along the link, those changes are recorded on the `segment_link` table. Lanes are numbered sequentially, starting at either the centerline (two-way street) or the left shoulder (one-way street or divided highway with two centerlines).

fields.description: Primary key
fields.name: lane_id

fields.description: Required. Foreign key to link table.
fields.name: link_id

fields.description: Required. e.g., -1, 1, 2 (use left-to-right numbering). By convention, the left-most through lane is 1. Left-turn lanes have negative numbers
fields.name: lane_num

fields.description: Optional. Set of allowed uses that should appear in either the use_definition or use_group tables; comma-separated.
fields.name: allowed_uses

categories.label: a vehicle can change lanes, provided that the vehicle-type is permitted in the destination lane
a regulatory prohibition (e.g., a double-white solid line) against changing lanes, but no physical barrier
a physical barrier (e.g., a bollard, curb, Jersey barrier) is in place

fields.description: Optional. Whether a barrier exists to prevent vehicles from changing lanes to the right.
fields.name: r_barrier

categories.label: a vehicle can change lanes, provided that the vehicle-type is permitted in the destination lane
a regulatory prohibition (e.g., a double-white solid line) against changing lanes, but no physical barrier
a physical barrier (e.g., a bollard, curb, Jersey barrier) is in place

fields.description: Optional. Whether a barrier exists to prevent vehicles from changing lanes to the left
fields.name: l_barrier

fields.description: Optional. Width of the lane, short_length units.
fields.name: width

schema.name: lane.schema.json
